name: sigunu
description: Live video-chat platform for team-based quizzes

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sigunu/shared && concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:server" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sigunu/shared && npm run build -w @sigunu/server && npm run build -w @sigunu/web
